method: Fit one right sandal on the shared 30-degree heel pose: uniform scale to foot length, footbed SOLE_GAP under the posed sole, stiletto tip on the forefoot ground, rings radially RING_CLEARANCE off the ankle, ARAP for the straps, outward push for any strap inside the skin. Mirror for the left, then inverse-skin both into the canonical bind pose and store heel_pose in scene extras like the knight boots.
weights: Rings take the ankle skin Leg/Foot split smoothed along each ring, buckles their ring mean; heel strap Foot at the seat blending into the bottom ring weights; sole, cup and post Foot; ToeBase up to 0.2 past the ball (the knight boots cap), ramping in over 1 cm above the ground so the sole bottom stays level.
